answer: A gale is cheap until prism, the single accumulator for key, endpoint and nonce, merges equal records. Renewal uses one incremental folding proof: the kth gale is folded after all earlier records and must show difference from every live gale, burning pearl for each gate. One dependent chain makes n gale cost about n^2 pearl, with no parallel prover. This fails when dedup is lax, folding shards, or pearl is rented.
